meeting: Post Quantum Transaction Signature (PQTS) Breakout #13 - August 19, 2026

circle_pq_transition_concerns.highlight: Circle's primary concern: ecosystem fragmentation across 30 blockchains leading to incompatible PQ signature schemes
Hot wallets sign 30K–70K tx/day; stateful schemes (e.g. XMSS) require key rotation and are operationally unacceptable
SLH-DSA preferred (stateless); 200K gas cost is concern but can be mitigated via ERC-3009 batching
Circle deployed SLH-DSA (SHA-2) precompile on ARC testnet; deferring parameter choices pending Ethereum alignment

ec_recover_hotfix_proposal.highlight: Proposal: repurpose EC Recover's V byte as a version number; use R/S (64 bytes) as pointers to PQ pubkey/signature in a registry contract
Maintains existing ABI; deployed contracts accepting ECDSA could transition to PQ without code changes
Frame transactions could carry the PQ signature inline, replacing need to pre-register signatures in a table

organizational.highlight: Antonio to present 13-call PQTS recap at next Thursday's ACDE; will note community leaning toward hash-based over lattice/precompile approach

action_items.action: Mira to draft EIP formalizing EC Recover hotfix / PQ registry approach, incorporating frame transactions
Present PQTS 13-call summary at ACDE; flag shift away from lattice/precompile toward hash-based signatures

decisions.decision: Community sentiment across 13 PQTS calls has moved away from lattice-based schemes and precompiles toward hash-based (stateless) transaction signatures; no formal protocol decision yet — governance remains with ACDE

targets.target: PQTS recap presentation at ACDE — next Thursday (approx. August 28, 2026)
